desc: Introducing the Breek Arms WARHAMMER Mod2 ambidextrous charging handle. This simple, affordable upgrade makes your AR-15 easier to operate with textured grooves and wide, setback latches that let you charge the rifle quickly from either side, even with large gloves, while the low-profile design clears big optics without sacrificing function. Machined from 7075-T6 aluminum and featuring improved gas-relief cuts and a raised shelf to divert blowback away from the shooter, the Mod2 improves comfort and reliability when running suppressed and is the smart upgrade for your rifle this season.
